rationale.text: The page's own iframe has a title, but the cross-site document it shows contains a visible iframe without a title attribute. That inner frame is displayed in the page, and the test asks each frame for a title attribute. The custom check examines every frame element in the top document and in every document nested in it, reads the cross-site document and faults the inner frame (step 5), so the finding is failed at both levels.

citations.quote: Chaque cadre (balise `<iframe>` ou `<frame>`) a-t-il un attribut `title`
Pour chaque cadre, vérifier qu’il possède un attribut
Cadre en ligne : élément HTML (balise <iframe>) permettant d’afficher un contenu dans la page web dans laquelle il est implémenté.
